cohort: Participants were 8275 infants who had a history of hospitalization in the NICU at participating institutions in Japan between 2010 and 2014.
finding: Among infants admitted to the NICU, children with neonatal sepsis were more likely to have a history of Kawasaki disease at 3 years of age (aOR: 11.67), and antibiotic use in the NICU may also be an independent risk factor.
